Ashgrove: \(4,390\) megalitres ÷ \(58,760\) residents ÷ 365 days × 1,000,000 = 204.7 litres per resident per day.

Ashgrove used more, by 4.8 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Ashgrove | 4.8
